invariants.statement: Protocol facts, indexed observations, artist declarations, and PND editorial decisions remain distinguishable.
The web does not scan the chain for storable browse, profile, ownership, media, or historical data.
Ponder owns fixed shared contracts and discovery; the worker owns known-artist long-tail token scanning and enrichment.
Independence is an available capability, not an automatically inferred or publicly scored artist state.
Independent release minting and rendering do not require PND APIs or PND-hosted data.
Curation appears only through an explicitly authored object, never inferred wallet behavior.
Projected added recurring cost above ten US dollars per month requires explicit approval.
Performance, indexing, availability, media, and preview acceptance use representative live data, not dummy content.

acceptanceGates.description: Public claims map to durable evidence with coverage, freshness, and finality where applicable.
No browse or profile path adds request-time historical or per-token chain scanning.
PND and artist interfaces pass the same shared release behavior tests.
The artist template retains core rendering and transaction behavior with PND endpoints blocked.
The integration preview uses representative live read-only production data and no dummy content.
Image, video, HTML, loading, unavailable, and failed media states are explicitly reviewed.
The required desktop and 390px mobile route matrix passes without page-level overflow.
Representative mobile routes meet the documented Web Vitals targets or have an approved measured exception.
RPC, database, storage, and hosting effects are measured and remain inside the approved recurring-cost boundary.
Migration, deployment, activation, rollback, and observation order are explicit.
Canonical docs, program state, decisions, and verification receipts match the shipped behavior.

risks.condition: Netlify web and Railway readers do not share one validated indexer_live target.
risks.control: Complete the fresh versioned backfill and guarded alias cutover before activating dependent public claims.

risks.condition: Open collection, gallery, preservation, management, and profile PRs modify shared Surface and navigation paths.
risks.control: Select shipping Surface work, then rebase and resolve overlapping paths once before creating new dependent worktrees.

risks.condition: An auction lot that refuses transfer can permanently lock a winning bid.
risks.control: Resolve or explicitly exclude the affected auction path before the integrated venue activation.

risks.condition: The artist template and PND app carry copied render and transaction behavior that can diverge.
risks.control: Merge a shared provider-driven kernel and enforce parity plus PND-offline tests.

risks.condition: Historical Surface and Editions plans contain stale branch, contract, and deployment claims.
risks.control: Use the documentation registry and mark completed plans historical instead of treating them as active state.
